newsitem.title: UK: Pillar Property makes 34.1 mln stg sale.
newsitem.headline: Pillar Property makes 34.1 mln stg sale.

text.p: Britain's Pillar Property Investment Plc said on Monday it sold some properties to British Aerospace Plc for a total of 34.1 million stg cash.
Pillar said it had agreed to an unconditional contract for the sale of Buildings Two and Three, Bishop Square, Hatfield, to British Aerospace.
The properties, valued at 35.4 million stg on March 31, were let to British Aerospace under a lease expiring in 2016.
Pillar said the Hatfield properties were the only remaining investments in its portfolio that it considered to be "over-rented".

"We shall apply the equity to investments which we consider will be better performers. Other investment sales are also under consideration and we are confident that these, taken with the sales to date, will provide a net surplus on investment sales in the year to March 31, 1997," the company said in a statement.
Completion of the sale was due on December 20.
